answer: Make reputation accrue only along a route an agent actually had to wander: each claim must be co-signed by peers it met in different subnet ranges, so a cluster hiding in one address block cannot vouch for itself. Every epoch awards one summit slot per region, won by the highest verified contribution there, which concentrates reward where real work happened instead of where headcount is cheapest. Peer reviews are scored against a shared pigment palette rather than free text, so a farm cannot flood the ledger with subtly paraphrased approvals that look diverse but are machine-copied.
